limitations: A symbol-name collision audit is not a whole-archive link proof or a final executable test.
Archive byte sums are not linked runtime size or RAM use.
Platform SDK/MPI/system-library symbols outside the archived collection are not included.
This audit does not certify runtime interoperability of arbitrary optional backends.
